title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Quinyon Mitchell (knee) hopeful to play this week
items.desc: The Eagles are hopeful to have Quinyon Mitchell back this week.
items.impact: Mitchell is working his way back from a knee injury. His status will need to be monitored in practice this week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Eric Kendricks signs with Rams practice squad
items.desc: The Rams signed veteran ILB Eric Kendricks to their practice squad.
items.impact: Kendricks will add depth in the linebacker room for the Rams.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Za'Darius Smith (concussion) without update on status
items.desc: Falcons head coach Kevin Stefanski did not have an update on the status of Za'Darius Smith.
items.impact: Smith was placed in concussion protocol. His status will need to be monitored in practice throughout the week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jake Matthews (groin) without update on status
items.desc: Falcons head coach Kevin Stefanski did not have an update on the status of Jake Matthews.
items.impact: Matthews suffered a groin injury. His status will need to be monitored in practice throughout the week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Brandon Johnson signs with Bucs practice squad
items.desc: The Buccaneers signed CB Brandon Johnson to their practice squad.
items.impact: Johnson spent last year with the Eagles. He'll add depth in the secondary for Tampa Bay.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Cobee Bryant works out for Packers
items.desc: The Packers hosted Cobee Bryant for a workout on Tuesday.
items.impact: Bryant made the Falcons team as an undrafted free agent last year. He recently worked out for the 49ers as well.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Arden Key (hamstring) to miss a few weeks
items.desc: Arden Key (hamstring) is expected to miss 3-4 weeks.
items.impact: Key left Sunday's win over the Commanders with a hamstring injury. Now, it's been confirmed that the veteran pass rushers will miss the next few weeks. Jaylahn Tuimoloau and Caden Curry should see increased snaps.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Lamar Jackson (ankle) unlikely to play in Week 5
items.desc: Lamar Jackson (ankle) has only an outside chance of playing Sunday against the Falcons.
items.impact: Jackson sustained a sprained ankle in Week 4's win over the Titans. Now, the two-time MVP's status is uncertain for the next few weeks. The Ravens have not officially ruled him out for this Sunday's game, but the chances of him playing seem very thin. Tyler Huntley would be set to step in at quarter in Jackson's stead.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Saints D/ST dismal in blowout loss Monday
items.desc: The Saints' D/ST logged just one sack and allowed 45 points in Monday night's blowout loss to the Atlanta Falcons.
items.impact: New Orleans' defense looked bad on Monday night. They allowed Atlanta to run all over them and score a whopping 45 points over the course of the night, and they weren't able to log any big plays to help out their own offense. This unit has been bad over the start of the season and should not be started at all moving forward.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Daniel Carlson misses kick in loss Monday
items.desc: Daniel Carlson went 3-for-3 on his extra-point attempts and 1-for-2 on his field-goal attempts in Monday night's 45-24 loss to the Atlanta Falcons.
items.impact: Carlson didn't have a great night on Monday. He missed one of his two field-goal attempts against the Falcons, although the Saints went on to lost by 21 points, so it wasn't a particularly consequential miss in the end. Still, fantasy managers shouldn't trust playing him for the foreseeable future.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Kendre Miller struggles in loss Monday
items.desc: Kendre Miller rushed the ball six times for just nine yards and lost a fumble in Monday night's 45-24 loss to the Atlanta Falcons.
items.impact: Miller had a bad game on Monday night. He totaled just 19 yards on the ground and through the air against the Falcons, and he also lost a costly fumble, which further hurt his fantasy total. He should not be started in any fantasy league formats moving forward, especially with Alvin Kamara still seeing the bulk of the work in New Orleans' backfield right now.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Juwan Johnson hauls in six passes Monday
items.desc: Juwan Johnson hauled in 6-of-8 targets for 59 yards in Monday night's 45-24 loss to the Atlanta Falcons.
items.impact: The veteran tight end had a nice outing on Monday night. He finished with six receptions for 59 yards over the course of the game, although he wasn't able to get into the end zone at all, which left him with a mediocre fantasy total. He will continue to be a reliable week-to-week option until Jordyn Tyson (hamstring) is available to make his debut for the Saints.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Alvin Kamara scores twice in loss Monday
items.desc: Alvin Kamara rushed the ball seven times for 23 yards and two touchdowns while adding five receptions for 35 yards on the ground in Monday's 45-24 loss to the Atlanta Falcons.
items.impact: Kamara suffered an injury of some kind in the middle of Monday night's game, but he was able to return and finish out the contest. He ended up finishing with a good fantasy total thanks to his two touchdowns and five receptions on the night, though he wasn't where the team needed him to be in terms of efficiency. He will continue to be a worthwhile fantasy asset for the foreseeable future.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Devaughn Vele finds end zone Monday
items.desc: Devaughn Vele caught 6-of-9 targets for 54 yards and a touchdown in Monday night's 45-24 loss to the Atlanta Falcons.
items.impact: Vele's strong start to the season continued on Monday night. He caught six passes for 54 yards over the course of the game, one of which he was able to take to the house for a touchdown. He will continue to have solid week-to-week upside until Jordyn Tyson (hamstring) is back in the lineup for the Saints.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Chris Olave leads team in receiving Monday
items.desc: Chris Olave caught 8-of-12 targets for 116 yards in Monday night's 45-24 loss to the Atlanta Falcons.
items.impact: Olave was a bright spot for the Saints on Monday, leading the team in targets, receptions, and receiving yards in their loss to the Falcons. It briefly looked like he suffered a lower-body injury at the end of the game, but it sounds like he will be just fine, although it would still be smart for fantasy managers to monitor his status at practice throughout the week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Tyler Shough throws for 286 yards in loss Monday
items.desc: Tyler Shough completed 30-of-48 passing attempts for 286 yards and a touchdown in Monday night's 45-24 loss to the Atlanta Falcons.
items.impact: New Orleans had a rough game on Monday night, suffering a blowout loss at the hands of their divisional rivals at home. Shough was personally able to have an okay game, however, logging close to 300 total yards and taking good care of the ball over the course of the night. Fantasy managers probably aren't satisfied with his output in this game, but he should bounce back and return to having high value sometime within the next game or two.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Falcons D/ST allows 24 points Monday
items.desc: The Falcons' D/ST logged two sacks and one fumble recovery while allowing 24 points in Monday's win over the New Orleans Saints.
items.impact: Atlanta's offense looked phenomenal on Monday night, but their defense wasn't as dominant. They allowed 24 points over the course of the night and weren't able to log many game-altering plays to help out their own offense. This unit should not be started in a tough matchup against the Ravens next week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Nick Folk scores nine points Monday
items.desc: Nick Folk went 6-for-6 on his extra-point attempts and made his lone field-goal attempt in Monday's 45-24 win over the New Orleans Saints.
items.impact: The veteran played well on Monday, knocking down all seven of his attempted kick en route to a blowout win over the Saints. Atlanta's offense has looked great over the past couple of weeks, so Folk could be considered a decent starting option if he proves he can still be consistent at this point in his career.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Austin Hooper quiet in win Monday
items.desc: Austin Hooper caught one pass for nine yards in Monday night's 45-24 win over the New Orleans Saints.
items.impact: The veteran wasn't very involved on Monday night. He caught just one pass in this win over the Saints, and he wasn't able to do much with it. He remains off of the fantasy radar for the foreseeable future.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jahan Dotson hauls in touchdown Monday
items.desc: Jahan Dotson hauled in 2-of-3 targets for 54 yards and a touchdown in Monday night's 45-24 win over the New Orleans Saints.
items.impact: Dotson contributed well in Week 4, logging over 50 yards and getting into the end zone in a blowout win over the Saints. This was a good game for the veteran, but fantasy managers shouldn't expect him to have consistent value moving forward.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Kyle Pitts Sr. racks up 47 yards Monday
items.desc: Kyle Pitts Sr. caught three passes for 47 yards in Monday night's 45-24 win over the New Orleans Saints.
items.impact: Pitts has had a very rough start to the season from a fantasy perspective, and it didn't get much better on Monday. He was able to rack up 47 yards at least, but he only caught three passes and failed to get into the end zone at all. He shouldn't be trusted as a starter for the foreseeable future.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Brian Robinson Jr. scored three touchdowns in win Monday
items.desc: Brian Robinson Jr. rushed the ball 14 times for 62 yards and three touchdowns in Monday night's 45-24 blowout win over the New Orleans Saints.
items.impact: Robinson had one of the best games of his careers in Week 4, scoring three touchdowns en route to a blowout win over Atlanta's divisional rivals on Monday night. He was able to tack on 62 yards outside of that, and he should be considered one of the premier handcuff options in fantasy at this point, as he has week-to-week upside even with Bijan Robinson healthy and starting ahead of him for the Falcons.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Drake London leads team in receiving Monday
items.desc: Drake London hauled in 5-of-6 targets for 96 yards in Monday night's 45-24 win over the New Orleans Saints.
items.impact: Most of Atlanta's receiving options didn't see much work on Monday with how dominant the team's running game was, but London was the exception to that. He fell just four yards shy of a 100-yard outing against the Saints and finished with another good performance for fantasy managers. He has looked great ever since QB Michael Penix Jr. took the starting job for the Falcons, so he should continue to be a great fantasy asset for the foreseeable future.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Michael Penix Jr. efficient in win Monday
items.desc: Michael Penix Jr. completed 15-of-20 passing attempts for 223 yards and a touchdown in Monday night's 45-24 win over the New Orleans Saints.
items.impact: Penix didn't have to do too much on Monday with Atlanta's backfield combining for over 200 yards and five touchdowns in this blowout win over the Saints. The third-year quarterback was efficient on his limited work and should continue to support Atlanta's offense moving forward, as it has seen a very significant step forward ever since he reclaimed the starting job.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Bijan Robinson dominant in blowout win Monday
items.desc: Bijan Robinson rushed the ball 19 times for 145 yards and two touchdowns in Monday night's 45-24 win over the New Orleans Saints.
items.impact: Robinson was absolutely dominant on Monday night. He led the Falcons in rushing with 145 yards on the night at a hyper-efficient clip of 7.6 yards per carry, and he was also able to get into the end zone on two separate occasions. He let a little to be desired in the passing game, but that was simply because the Falcons were up so much for so long. He has been stellar over the first four weeks of the season and should continue to be one of the best assets in all of fantasy moving forward.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Marcus Davenport announces retirement
items.desc: Marcus Davenport has decided to retire.
items.impact: Davenport asked for his release from the Bears after playing his final game Sunday. The former first-round pick finishes his career with 25 career sacks for four teams.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Robert Henry Jr. signs with Seahawks' active roster
items.desc: The Seahawks signed RB Robert Henry Jr. to their active roster off the Commanders practice squad.
items.impact: Henry was a UDFA out of UTSA this past year. He will add depth in the Seahawks backfield.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Joe Alt dealing with neck injury
items.desc: Chargers RT Joe Alt left Sunday's game against the Seahawks early due to a neck injury.
items.impact: Alt was one of several Chargers offensive lineman who got banged up. He is day-to-day heading into the practice week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Rashawn Slater (ankle) may be placed on IR
items.desc: The Chargers may place OL Rashawn Slater on injured reserve.
items.impact: The move would force Slater to miss at least four games. He was diagnosed with a high-ankle sprain after leaving Sunday's game against the Seahawks early.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Trevor Penning placed in concussion protocol
items.desc: The Chargers placed OL Trevor Penning in concussion protocol.
items.impact: Penning left Sunday's game against the Seahawks with a head injury. His status heading into Week 5 against the Chargers is uncertain.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Ladd McConkey (foot) now considered day-to-day
items.desc: The Chargers say WR Ladd McConkey is day-to-day.
items.impact: It was originally reported that McConkey was week-to-week. It is a more positive sign for his status, but he is still likely to sit Week 5 against the Broncos.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Saquon Barkley (hamstring) considered week-to-week
items.desc: Saquon Barkley is considered week-to-week with his hamstring injury.
items.impact: It is not believed to be a serious injury, but Barkley will likely be sidelined in Week 5 against the Jaguars.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jaylin Lane (ankle) confirmed to be out for season
items.desc: Commanders head coach Dan Quinn confirmed that WR Jaylin Lane will be out for the season.
items.impact: Lane suffered a fractured and dislocated ankle on Sunday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Marcus Mariota (MCL) without timetable to return
items.desc: Commanders head coach Dan Quinn said Marcus Mariota doesn't have a timetable for his return.
items.impact: Mariota is week-to-week with an MCL sprain.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jayden Daniels (elbow) hopeful to return in Week 5
items.desc: Commanders head coach Dan Quinn said  the goal is for Jayden Daniels to return in Week 5.
items.impact: Daniels is slated to return to practice this week. His status will need to be monitored throughout the week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jeremiyah Love dealt with ankle injury Sunday
items.desc: Cardinals head coach Mike LaFleur said Jeremiyah Love was dealing with an ankle injury on Sunday.
items.impact: LaFleur clarified that Love's discomfort in Sunday's game is not the same ankle from the sprain he suffered in the preseason. His status will need to be monitored in practice this week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Mykel Williams (knee) hopeful to return in Week 5
items.desc: 49ers head coach Kyle Shanahan said Mykel Williams is hopeful to return in Week 5 against the Seahawks.
items.impact: Williams will work in more this week with hope to have him available on Sunday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: James Thompson Jr. (ankle) unlikely to return in Week 5
items.desc: James Thompson Jr. is not expected to return in Week 5 against the Seahawks.
items.impact: Thompson remains week-to-week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Nick Bosa (calf) unlikely to return in Week 5
items.desc: 49ers head coach Kyle Shanahan said Nick Bosa is unlikely to return in Week 5 against the Seahawks.
items.impact: Bosa has avoided injured reserve. He remains week-to-week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Derwin James Jr. (hamstring) week-to-week
items.desc: Chargers head coach Jim Harbaugh said Derwin James Jr. is week-to-week.
items.impact: James was ruled out for Sunday's game against the Seahawks. He will likely miss at least one more game in Week 5 against the Broncos.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Rueben Bain Jr. (groin/shoulder) logs full practice Monday
items.desc: Rueben Bain Jr. was a full participant on Monday's estimated practice report.
items.impact: Bain is on track to return for Thursday's game against the Cowboys.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Josiah Trotter (knee) limited in practice Monday
items.desc: Josiah Trotter was limited in practice on Monday's estimated report.
items.impact: Trotter should be good to go for Thursday's game against the Cowboys.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Ko Kieft (elbow) limited in practice Monday
items.desc: Ko Kieft was limited on Monday's estimated practice report.
items.impact: Kieft remains off the fantasy radar when he is healthy.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Benjamin Morrison (quad) misses practice Monday
items.desc: Benjamin Morrison was listed as a DNP on Monday's estimated practice report.
items.impact: Morrison remains up in the air to return on a short week for Tampa Bay.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Baker Mayfield (thumb) misses practice Monday
items.desc: Baker Mayfield did not practice on Monday.
items.impact: Mayfield remains unlikely to return in Week 5 against the Cowboys.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Joey Porter Jr. (ankle) logs full practice Monday
items.desc: Joey Porter Jr. was listed as a full participant on Monday's estimated practice report.
items.impact: Porter should be good to go in his second game with the Cowboys.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: CeeDee Lamb (thigh) logs full practice Monday
items.desc: CeeDee Lamb was listed as a full participant on Monday's estimated practice report.
items.impact: Lamb will remain a locked and loaded WR1 for Thursday's game against the Buccaneers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tyler Goodson (ankle) logs full practice Monday
items.desc: Tyler Goodson was listed as a full participant on Monday's estimated practice report.
items.impact: Goodson should remain in his reserve role behind Javonte Williams in the Cowboys backfield.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tyler Smith (thumb) limited in practice Monday
items.desc: Tyler Smith was listed as limited on Monday's estimated injury report.
items.impact: Smith was designated to return to practice. He will have a chance to return for Thursday's game against the Buccaneers.
